Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare

 h_status varchar2(10);
 curr_rec number;
 dup_flg1 number:=0;
 dup_flg2 number:=0;
 ins_flg number:=0;

begin

 if :all_donor_ids.id_type is null then
 show_error('18083'); /* ID Type cannot be null */
 end if;

 /* Check duplicates in the database */
 
 begin
 select 1
 into dup_flg1
 from all_donor_ids
 where id_type=:all_donor_ids.id_type
 and rownum=1;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;

 if dup_flg1=1 then
 show_error('18084'); /* Duplicate ID Type */
 end if;
 
 /*Check duplicate recs which have not yet got committed */

 check_insert_rg('RG_IDTYPE','C10',:all_donor_ids.id_type||',',
 'C',dup_flg2);

 if dup_flg2=1 then
 show_error('18084'); /* Duplicate ID Type */
 end if;

 /* Insert the record into Record Group */

 
 check_insert_rg('RG_IDTYPE','C10',
 :all_donor_ids.id_type||',',
 'U',ins_flg);

 if ins_flg =1 then
 show_error('9199'); /*Unique row insertion failed in internal record group processing*/
 end if;

end;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHERFORM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHERFORM (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
chk_pass varchar2(1);

begin

 if :system.form_status !='QUERY' then
 check_password(:banner.prog_name,chk_pass); /*Check whether this program is allowed to commit */
 if chk_pass='Y' then /* If allowed to commit then commit */
 commit_form;
 if :system.form_status='QUERY' then /* If it's committed successfully the show message transaction committed */
 show_error('9163');
 end if;
 end if;
 else
 show_error('9162');/* Show message No changes to commit, if the form is in query mode */
 end if;

end;
